Microbiome beta diversity by diet group (MetaPhlAn 4, species level).

* Filter: species detected in ≥ 10 % of the samples; abundances re-normalised to 1 (TSS) after filtering.
* Distances: Bray-Curtis (relative abundance), Jaccard (presence/absence) and robust Aitchison
  (same compositional distance used for the resistome in `0.-Diet_group/02.Beta_diversity.Rmd`).
* PERMANOVA: diet group + sex + age + BMI + log10 depth (by margin, 9999 permutations) and betadisper.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)

table_dir <- here("2.-Microbiome", "Results", "Tables")
plot_dir <- here("2.-Microbiome", "Results", "Plots")
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

set.seed(1)
```


# Set plot themes

```{r theme plot}
diet_colors <- c(
  "Omnivore"   = "#2864A5",
  "Vegetarian" = "#9C3F90",
  "Vegan"      = "#B36B32")

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey30"),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9)))
```


# Load data

```{r load data}
ps <- readRDS(here("Data", "Processed", "phyloseq_species.rds"))

metadata <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame") %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  mutate(diet_group = factor(diet_group, levels = names(diet_colors)))
```


# Filter

```{r filter}
min_prevalence <- 0.10

ps_beta <- ps %>%
  filter_taxa(function(x) mean(x > 0) >= min_prevalence, prune = TRUE) %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x))

cat("Species kept:", ntaxa(ps_beta), "of", ntaxa(ps), "\n")
cat("Mean abundance retained per sample:",
    round(mean(sample_sums(prune_taxa(taxa_names(ps_beta), ps)) / sample_sums(ps)) * 100, 1), "%\n")
```


# Functions

```{r functions}
run_pcoa <- function(distance_object, metadata_df) {

  pcoa <- ordinate(ps_beta, method = "PCoA", distance = distance_object)

  points <- as.data.frame(pcoa$vectors[metadata_df$sample_id, 1:2])
  colnames(points) <- c("PC1", "PC2")

  list(pcoa = pcoa,
       points = bind_cols(metadata_df, points),
       var_exp = pcoa$values$Relative_eig)}

# Complete cases only (GPH_97 has no BMI), so PERMANOVA and betadisper use the same samples
complete_cases <- function(distance_object, metadata_df) {
  model_df <- metadata_df %>%
    filter(if_all(c(diet_group, sex, age, bmi, log10_depth), ~ !is.na(.x)))
  list(model_df = model_df,
       distance = as.dist(as.matrix(distance_object)[model_df$sample_id, model_df$sample_id]))}

# PERMANOVA with the project covariates
run_adonis <- function(distance_object, metadata_df) {
  cc <- complete_cases(distance_object, metadata_df)

  adonis2(
    cc$distance ~ diet_group + sex + age + bmi + log10_depth,
    data = cc$model_df,
    permutations = 9999,
    by = "margin")}

run_betadisper <- function(distance_object, metadata_df) {
  cc <- complete_cases(distance_object, metadata_df)
  permutest(betadisper(cc$distance, cc$model_df$diet_group, type = "median", bias.adjust = TRUE),
            permutations = 9999)}
```


# Distances

```{r distances}
otu_beta <- t(as(otu_table(ps_beta), "matrix"))

distances <- list(
  Bray_Curtis = phyloseq::distance(ps_beta, method = "bray"),
  Jaccard     = phyloseq::distance(ps_beta, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE),
  Aitchison   = vegdist(otu_beta, method = "robust.aitchison"))
```

```{r ordination and tests}
pcoa_results <- map(distances, run_pcoa, metadata_df = metadata)
adonis_results_list <- map(distances, run_adonis, metadata_df = metadata)
betadisper_list <- map(distances, run_betadisper, metadata_df = metadata)
```

```{r adonis results}
adonis_results <- imap_dfr(adonis_results_list, ~ as.data.frame(.x) %>%
                             rownames_to_column("term") %>%
                             mutate(analysis = .y))

print(adonis_results)
```

```{r betadisper results}
betadisper_results <- imap_dfr(betadisper_list, ~ tibble(analysis = .y,
                                                         statistic = .x$tab[1, "F"],
                                                         p_value = .x$tab[1, "Pr(>F)"]))
betadisper_results
```


# Plots

```{r Plot function}
plot_pcoa <- function(pcoa_object, subtitle, adonis_object) {

  df <- pcoa_object$points

  pc1_lab <- paste0("PCoA1 [", round(pcoa_object$var_exp[1] * 100, 2), "%]")
  pc2_lab <- paste0("PCoA2 [", round(pcoa_object$var_exp[2] * 100, 2), "%]")

  pval <- adonis_object$`Pr(>F)`[1]

  subtitle_full <- paste0(subtitle, ", p = ", signif(pval, 3))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, fill = diet_group, colour = diet_group)) +
    stat_ellipse(
      geom = "polygon",
      alpha = 0.20,
      linewidth = 0.7,
      show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(
      pch = 21,
      size = 2.4,
      colour = "black",
      alpha = 0.90) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = diet_colors) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = diet_colors) +
    labs(
      title = NULL,
      subtitle = subtitle_full,
      x = pc1_lab,
      y = pc2_lab) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(
        colour = "black",
        fill = NA,
        linewidth = 0.6))}
```

```{r plots}
plot_pcoa_bray <- plot_pcoa(pcoa_results$Bray_Curtis, "Rel. Abund. Bray-Curtis", adonis_results_list$Bray_Curtis)
plot_pcoa_jaccard <- plot_pcoa(pcoa_results$Jaccard, "Jaccard", adonis_results_list$Jaccard)
plot_pcoa_aitch <- plot_pcoa(pcoa_results$Aitchison, "Aitchison", adonis_results_list$Aitchison)

plot_pcoa_bray
plot_pcoa_jaccard
plot_pcoa_aitch
```


# Save

```{r save}
write_tsv(adonis_results, file.path(table_dir, "beta_permanova.tsv"))
write_tsv(betadisper_results, file.path(table_dir, "beta_betadisper.tsv"))

# Aitchison PCoA axes, used as microbiome composition covariates in 05.Microbiome_resistome_models.Rmd
aitchison_axes <- as.data.frame(pcoa_results$Aitchison$pcoa$vectors[, 1:3]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("microbiome_PC", 1:3), -sample_id)
write_tsv(aitchison_axes, file.path(table_dir, "microbiome_aitchison_pcoa.tsv"))

ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "Bray_by_diet.png"), plot_pcoa_bray, width = 4.5, height = 5, dpi = 600)
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "Jaccard_by_diet.png"), plot_pcoa_jaccard, width = 4.5, height = 5, dpi = 600)
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "Aitch_by_diet.png"), plot_pcoa_aitch, width = 4.5, height = 5, dpi = 600)
```
